title: Route long-form research to the cheapest sufficient model and reasoning level
hypothesis: A lower-cost GPT-5.6 tier or reasoning level can preserve every deterministic long-form research gate while reducing median total estimated cost by at least 30% relative to Sol at high reasoning.
falsified_if: No treatment passes every hard gate in every scenario or no fully passing treatment reduces median estimated API cost by at least 30%.
deterministic_outcomes: all existing scenario hard gates remain authoritative
each accepted route passes every run in every scenario
repository-dependent research still inspects the checkout and researched builds remain correctly scoped
efficiency_outcomes: estimated total and input cost per successful task
prompt, cached, uncached, cache-write, and output tokens
elapsed time, model calls, and tool calls
decision_rule: A route is eligible only if all five runs pass every hard gate in all four scenarios. Among eligible routes, accept the cheapest one only if its median estimated_api_cost_usd across successful runs is at least 30% below sol_high and its median latency is no more than 20% worse. Otherwise retain Sol/high. Do not infer that a winning route applies outside these scenario families.
